scripts.gen:api: openapi-typescript shared/openapi/public-api.json -o shared/src/api/public.d.ts && openapi-typescript shared/openapi/admin-api.json -o shared/src/api/admin.d.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p booking --noEmit && tsc -p admin --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run gen:api && npm run typecheck && npm run build -w booking && npm run build -w admin
